issue.title: Cycler offer-close project scope counts open #ref rows that bob-cli open_scope_count ignores
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-on.10.1.2 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and confirmed by the bob-cli-on.10.1 land agent by reading both implementations.

bob-cli `open_scope_count` (src/native/task_complete/offer_close.rs:705) counts, for a `^prj` project task, only `task_status_hooks::parse_tasks` rows (lines carrying the `#task` global filter) that are open and not the project line itself. The cycler mirror `successorOfferCloseOpenScopeCount` (bob-plugins plugins/task-status-cycler/src/089h-successor-offer-close-copy.js, project branch) also adds `successorKeepMovingReferenceTasks(noteText, path)`, so a top-level `- [ ] #ref …` reference row in the project note raises "its N open tasks stay open" in Obsidian but not in bob-cli's successor card.

Repro: a project note with `- [ ] #task #prj P ^prj`, one open `- [ ] #task Row` and one open `- [ ] #ref Some article`; close the ^prj through the cycler offer-close path (or call successorOfferCloseOpenScopeCount on that note) and compare with bob-cli's offer-close descriptor (SV vectors in tests/fixtures/offer_close/vectors.json): the cycler counts 2, bob-cli counts 1.

Fix: bob-cli is the authority. Decide whether open reference rows belong in the project scope count; record the rule as a new SV vector in bob-cli tests/fixtures/offer_close/vectors.json, re-copy it byte for byte into plugins/task-status-cycler/scripts/fixtures/offer_close/, and align whichever side differs (default: drop successorKeepMovingReferenceTasks from the cycler count). Requirement lines are already excluded on both sides (SV25).

task_type_fields.impact: The Obsidian close card overstates how many project tasks stay open whenever a project keeps reading-list rows; Mac and Obsidian cards disagree.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/task-status-cycler/src/089h-successor-offer-close-copy.js successorOfferCloseOpenScopeCount (project branch) vs bob-cli src/native/task_complete/offer_close.rs open_scope_count
task_type_fields.repro: Project note with '- [ ] #task #prj P ^prj', an open '- [ ] #task Row', and an open '- [ ] #ref Article': the cycler scope note says 2 open tasks stay open, bob-cli's offer-close descriptor says 1.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-on.10.1.2 found that the cycler and bob-cli disagree on a ^prj close's open-task count when the project note holds open #ref rows; the epic fixed only the requirement-line half (SV25).
